title: No-Copy Parser (span & string_view)

links.title: C++ Core Guidelines F.24: use span<T> for a half-open sequence

hints: A view is (pointer, length). Shrinking it is free: s.remove_prefix(1), s.remove_suffix(1), s.substr(pos, len) on a string_view; values.subspan(offset, count) on a span.
trim: while the view is non-empty and its front() is a space or tab, remove_prefix(1); same for back() with remove_suffix(1).
split: find(sep, start) in a loop; push s.substr(start, pos - start); when find returns npos push the rest and stop. An empty input gives one empty field.
longest_positive_run: track the start and length of the current run and of the best run, then return values.subspan(best_start, best_len).
